
```{r setup}
library(repulsiveDimples)
library(spatstat)

# We load data
data(turbulence)
dimples <- turbulence$dimples
sidelength <- turbulence$sidelength
timescale <- turbulence$timescale

inds <- seq(from = 2, to = length(dimples), by = ceiling(2*timescale))
dimples <- dimples[inds]
for(i in 1:length(dimples)){
  dimples[[i]] <- dimples[[i]]*sidelength
}
```

We estimate summary statistics of the data, $\hat{\rho}$, $\hat{K}(r)$, and the minimum distance $h$.

```{r hat_estimation}
rho_hat <- intensity_est(points_input = dimples, l = sidelength, timescale = 1)
K_hat <- K_est.unions(points_input = dimples, l = sidelength,
                      timescale = 1,
                      spacing = 5,
                      rMax = 4,
                      dr = 0.05)

min_dist <- find_min_dist(points_input = dimples, l = sidelength, timescale = timescale)
```

We find an initial parameter guess through ...

```{r initial_params}
start_fitted <- thomas.estK(X = K_hat, rmin = 2*min_dist, rmax = sidelength/3)$par
lambda <- -log(1 - pi*rho_hat*min_dist^2)/(pi*min_dist^2)
start_params <- log(c(start_fitted[1], start_fitted[2], lambda/start_fitted[1]))
names(start_params) <- c("kappa", "omega", "mu")
rm(start_fitted)
```

```{r parameter_fitting_thomas}
param_res <- min_contrast_trust_region_thomas(params = start_params,
                                              parFreeIndex = c(1, 2, 3),
                                              repRange = min_dist,
                                              thinningType = 3,
                                              rho_hat = rho_hat,
                                              K_hat = K_hat,
                                              xlims = c(0, 5),
                                              ylims = c(0, 5),
                                              nSims = 500,
                                              deltaInit = 0.2, 
                                              eta = 0.05, 
                                              deltaMax = 1.0, 
                                              deltaMin = 0.0001,
                                              wq = c(1000, 1/4), 
                                              normalized = TRUE, 
                                              eta_trust = 0.6, 
                                              eta_converged = 0.999,
                                              validate.converged = FALSE, 
                                              method.main = "quadratic", 
                                              method.prefit = "quadratic", 
                                              tolPrefitLoops = 10^-3,
                                              maxPrefitLoops = 4, 
                                              max.iter.prefit = 10,
                                              tol = 10^-6, 
                                              max.iter = 30)
```


```{r look_at_estimates_thomas}
exp(param_res$params)
```
